summary: Omnia Diabetes Care Portal - Full Authenticated Flow Testing Complete. All 15 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend dashboard, sugar log dialog, and diet plan dialog all verified working.
test_type: Omnia Diabetes Care Portal - Authenticated User Flow

tests.name: Omnia welcome screen displays for unauthenticated users
Welcome screen shows 'Take Control of Your Diabetes' title
Welcome screen has 'Go to Home & Login' button
Log Sugar quick action card present
Diet Plan quick action card present
Book Tests quick action card present
Warning Signs quick action card present
Sugar Log dialog opens with all form fields
Sugar Log dialog shows Reference Ranges info
Sugar reading saves successfully with toast notification
Saved reading appears in Recent Sugar Readings with status badge
Diet Plan dialog opens with Vegetarian/Non-Veg/Tips tabs

omnia_backend_apis.details: All 6 Omnia endpoints working: GET/POST profile, GET/POST/DELETE sugar-logs, GET sugar-stats. Proper auth checks (401 without token). Alert system working for low (<70), high (>180), very_high (>250) values.

omnia_welcome_screen.details: Welcome screen displays for unauthenticated users with 'Take Control of Your Diabetes' title, Login Required message, and Go to Home & Login button.

omnia_dashboard.details: Dashboard shows for authenticated users with: Emergency Guide banner, 4 quick action cards (Log Sugar, Diet Plan, Book Tests, Warning Signs), Recent Sugar Readings section, Order Medicine CTA.

omnia_sugar_log_dialog.details: Sugar Log dialog opens with Reading Type dropdown (FBS/PPBS/Random), Sugar Value input, Date/Time fields, Reference Ranges info card. Saves successfully with toast notification. Reading appears in Recent Sugar Readings with status badge (Normal/Pre-diabetic/High).

omnia_diet_plan_dialog.details: Diet Plan dialog opens with 3 tabs (Vegetarian, Non-Veg, Tips). Shows Indian-friendly meal guidance with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner/Snacks sections. Each item shows portion, calories, and health benefits. Includes recommended timings and dietitian disclaimer.

omnia_profile_setup.details: Profile setup dialog appears for new users with Diabetes Type dropdown, Age input, Gender dropdown. Can be skipped with 'Skip for now' button.

critical_code_review_comments: All Omnia backend endpoints properly check authentication and return 401 without token
Sugar log alert system correctly identifies low (<70), high (>180), and very_high (>250) values
Frontend properly handles authenticated vs unauthenticated states
Diet Plan dialog has comprehensive Indian-friendly meal options with nutritional info
seed_data_creation: Test user created via API registration. Sugar logs created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Omnia Diabetes Care Portal fully tested with authenticated user flow. All backend APIs working (profile CRUD, sugar logs CRUD, stats). Frontend dashboard, sugar log dialog, and diet plan dialog all verified. Test file: /app/tests/test_omnia_authenticated.py uses email/password registration to bypass SMS OTP requirement.
